title: Lund University campus tour (main campus in Lund)
description:
Want to take a guided tour of Lund University? In this video you can join our international student Rumbi, as she walks you through our main campus in Lund. 

Learn more about Lund University on www.lunduniversity.lu.se

Have questions about Bachelor's or Master's study opportunities? Get in touch with the International Marketing and Recruitment Team: https://www.lunduniversity.lu.se/admissions/connect-us-about-studies/online/contact-us-regarding-degree-studies

title: Bold Ideas Big Impact | Singapore Management University
description:
Singapore Management University (SMU). 
What begins here changes lives; what we do here changes the world.   

As Asia’s premier global city university, SMU drives innovation, transcends boundaries and transforms lives. From shaping graduates who think critically, act decisively, and lead with purpose, to advancing research that addresses societal challenges, and building partnerships around the world, SMU turns insight into action and bold ideas into transformative impact.

Bold Ideas. Big Impact.
Discover how SMU is shaping the future.
Learn more: https://sgsmu.com/boldideas

title: Award-winning podcaster and bestselling author Jay Shetty addresses Princeton's Class of 2025
description:
Jay Shetty, a bestselling author and host of the award-winning mental health podcast “On Purpose,” spoke to Princeton seniors at the Class Day ceremony on May 26. Class Day, which takes place the day before Commencement, is organized by members of the senior class, who choose the speaker.

Read the full story: https://bit.ly/3Z3qx41
